sentences.text: Diksha Kumari vs Pardeep Kumar on 12 November, 2024

Bench: J.K. Maheshwari, Rajesh Bindal
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition (Criminal) No. 578 Of 2024
 Diksha Kumari Petitioner(S)
 Versus
 Pardeep Kumar & Anr. Respondent(S)
 Order

1) The petitioner (wife) has filed this transfer petition seeking transfer of Cr. Reg. Case/7319/2022 arising out of FIR No. 0239/2021, under Sections 406/498A/323/342/419/ 420/467/471/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at P.S. Mahila Thana, Sri Ganga Nagar, titled as "State Vs Pardeep Kumar from the Court of Ld. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sri Ganga Nagar, Rajasthan to the Court of Ld. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, North, Rohini, Delhi.
2) As per office report dated 11th November, 2024, service is complete on the respondents, but there is no appearance on their behalf, though an opportunity was allowed by this Court.

3) Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner, in the facts, we deem it appropriate to allow this transfer petition and accordingly, Cr. Reg. Case/7319/2022 arising out of FIR No. 0239/2021, under Sections 406/498A/323/342/419/420/467/471/ 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at P.S. Mahila Thana, Sri Ganga Nagar, titled as State Vs Pardeep Kumar is ordered to be transferred from the Court of Ld. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sri Ganga Nagar, Rajasthan to the Court of Ld.
Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, North, Rohini.

entities.text: Court of Ld. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sri Ganga Nagar, Rajasthan
entities.label: COURT

entities.text:

Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, North, Rohini
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Delhi.
4) We clarify that the transferee Court on its discretion may allow the presence of the respondent No. 1 (husband) virtually until necessarily required and directed.

5) On intimation by e-mail, the records of the case be transferred to the transferee Court without any delay and immediate compliance be made.
6) The transfer petition is, accordingly, allowed.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.

., J.
[ J.K. MAHESHWARI ] ., J.
